announcement.title: Atualização
announcement.summary: Melhorias de gameplay, teleporte, loot e chat.
announcement.message: Confira as melhorias implementadas nesta atualização.
announcement.details:
• Raid Block e PvP Block removidos do Vanilla
• Raid Block do 2x não bloqueia mais muros altos e barricadas
• Loot do Patrol Helicopter melhorado no 2x
• Teleporte bloqueado dentro de monumentos
• Mensagens do chat padronizadas e aprimoradas
• Filtro do chat corrigido
• Novo filtro contra mensagens discriminatórias

announcement.summary_en: Gameplay, teleport, loot and chat improvements.
announcement.details_en:
Raid Block and PvP Block removed from Vanilla
• Raid Block on 2x no longer blocks high walls and barricades
• Improved Patrol Helicopter loot on 2x
• Teleport disabled inside monuments
• Chat messages standardized and improved
• Fixed chat filter
• Added filter against discriminatory messages
announcement.summary_es: Mejoras en la jugabilidad, teletransporte, botín y chat.
